prompts.prompt: Use case: identity-preserve. Asset: high-resolution full-body fighting-game sprite, transparent PNG, vertical 2:3. Edit the referenced Felipe Bleh into his evil CYBORG CLONE, preserving EXACTLY his recognisable face, curly dark hair, tall lean muscular proportions, facial age, and this same full-body guard pose facing right. Keep the black sleeveless school shirt and its white people-and-pen emblem recognisable, charcoal/beige darkened plaid trousers, black sneakers. Replace the LEFT HALF OF THE FACE AS SEEN BY THE VIEWER with fitted exposed brushed gunmetal mechanical plates and one small glowing red optical eye, leaving the OTHER HALF human and unmistakably the original man. Expose cybernetic metal on the arm on the viewer's LEFT, with fine crimson actuator seams; the other arm remains human. Add subtle dark mechanical knee braces and black metal finger joints; restrained, sleek, school-teacher turned dark mirror, not bulky power armor. Cold, stern expression. Match the reference's polished realistic arcade illustration, crisp facial detail and clean silhouette. Neutral balanced studio illumination, subtle red mechanical emissions. Both feet and all hair completely visible with ample transparent margin. GENUINE TRANSPARENT BACKGROUND, no magenta, no shadow on the ground, no UI, no wording, no surrounding scene. This is one single character, not a sheet.

Use case: lighting-weather / dystopian environment redesign. Asset: landscape 16:9 high-resolution 2D fighting-game arena background. Transform THIS EXACT reference classroom into a disturbing alternate-universe dystopian version while preserving the SAME CAMERA, room geometry, window with AC on the LEFT, whiteboard in center-left, green chalkboard in center-right, wall TV upper-right, teacher's desk at left and pushed-back student desks on both far sides, wide empty foreground fighting floor. The familiar blue Brazilian public-school walls are now weathered dark blue-gray with black branching organic cables and faint crimson light fissures, broken ceiling lights, dust and sparse ash in the air. The window shows an impossible dark storm sky glowing blood-red far away. Thin biomechanical tendrils wind along ceiling and wall edges, keeping the chalkboard and foreground readable. A distorted dim red reflection in the TV; faint chalk 'Filosofia' stays on the green board. Scuffed polished school floor clear across the lower THIRD for fighters' feet, with subtle red and icy blue reflections and perspective kept IDENTICAL to the reference. Elegant cinematic arcade realism, ominous deep navy and graphite with restrained crimson and cold silver illumination. Detailed and crisp, retain enough midtone light to distinguish fighters in dark clothes. NO people, no monsters, no fighters, no objects blocking the foreground, no game interface, no title, no watermark. An original alternate-world classroom, not a replica of any TV-series location.
